page0.text:
...I'll try asking him.
She's not one to reveal herself even to Issei, but I might be able to get some clues. Issei does live at the temple.

page1.text:
"Issei. What kind of person is that woman?
Is she from a foreign country? Does she always hide her appearance behind a turban-like cloth?"

page2.text:
"What is that? We would have kicked such a suspicious person out... I don't know why you're asking, but she is a legitimate guest.
...My brother entertains the idea that she's some servant of evil, but I rather like her. I've only spoken with her once, but she is a fair person, though she seems a little foul."

page3.text: "Oh, wow. It was worth asking this question, that's rare for you to praise a woman. What, did you fall in love?"

page4.text: "D-d-don't be ridiculous, fool! What I admire was that she doesn't look at herself. First of all, I can't fall in love with the lover of Souichirou, the one I look up to like a brother..."

page5.text:
Issei suddenly stops talking and lowers his face.
"Ah..."
He might've felt dizzy, as he falls face down on the table and doesn't move.

page6.text:
"Mm? What happened, Issei? Is it anemia?"
"...No, it's not that I feel bad."

page7.text:
He lifts himself suddenly.
I laugh, picturing him like a wind-up doll, suddenly full of energy.

page8.text:
"...Issei?"
I don't even look at my slashed stomach. My eyes go to the knife in Issei's hand.

page9.text: "You fell for my trap. The command that I have implanted in this human is activated only when he comes across someone that inquires about me."

page10.text:
A voice that doesn't belong to Issei, comes out of his mouth.
When I realize it's the voice of the Servant I met at Ryudou Temple...
"I do not need this doll anymore, either."
...It's like I'm looking in a mirror.

page11.text:
...
...My consciousness fades from the blood loss.
The wound. The pain from the wound reaching my organs isn't causing my consciousness to fade.

page12.text:
Instead of death from blood loss, eager to deny the sight before me, my mind rapidly freezes my consciousness.
Issei falls down before me, without knowing what's going on.
